scope: Baselines reported in the main navigation comparison.
parameter_source_priority: Official code defaults for unspecified values
Explicitly listed local adapter values when neither source specifies them
batch_semantics: Global effective batch, including all ranks and gradient accumulation.

common_evaluation.latency_scope: See appendix for hardware and concurrency of each archived cohort.

evaluated_checkpoint.selection_metric: Official DreamSim evaluation on the dev set
evaluated_checkpoint.selection_rule: Lowest recorded dev DreamSim error among evaluated checkpoints.

data_adapter.rgb: Original published frames, in numeric frame order.
data_adapter.pose_metadata: Planar integration of recorded commands from zero pose; not measured simulator poses.
data_adapter.sampling: Uniform offsets; without replacement when at least four are available.
data_adapter.image_transform: Official CenterCropAR with aspect ratio 4/3, resize 224x224, tensor conversion.
data_adapter.pixel_handling: Loader maps to [-1,1]; trainer restores [0,1] before RAE applies encoder normalization.
data_adapter.count_semantics: Published annotation/video records; no canonical physical-trajectory deduplication as used by InJepa and LWM.
data_adapter.scene_split_scope: RAE scene-hash partition, independent of the InJepa 50/11 building split.

LWM-CroCo.training_implementation: Local paper-based training adapter around released model/inference modules; upstream training code was not released.

training.schedule: Linear warmup, constant learning rate thereafter.

parameter_provenance.paper: WM Adam/50 epochs/batch8/LR5e-5/warmup5; policy Adam/40 epochs/batch24/LR1e-4/warmup4; two codebooks64; max64frames
parameter_provenance.source: Released model interfaces, action scaling, tokenization, and sampling defaults.
parameter_provenance.local_adapter_values_not_disclosed_by_pa: Global batch interpretation; Adam fine settings; constant LR after warmup; M4/epsilon0.01m; RL beta/clip/fixed IL reference; applying policy40/LR/warmup separately to RL because a separate RL budget is not disclosed
parameter_provenance.data_sampling: StreamVLN adaptation, NOT disclosed author recipe: physical trajectory dedup; one anchor per at-most-63-anchor bin per epoch; local no-replacement cycles; IL fixed epoch0 pairs; original model/loss/batch/LR/epochs unchanged.
parameter_provenance.policy_attention_heads: Four in the released executable module; six in the paper description. Reproduction retains the released module.

data_adapter.pose_metadata: Replay recorded actions from matched source episode reset pose in Habitat; retain measured poses aligned to original frame indices.
data_adapter.training_RGB: Original published RGB only; replay does not render new training images.
data_adapter.action_coordinates: Cumulative planar forward/left displacement and yaw relative to the origin.
data_adapter.partition: Seeded hash of physical trajectory identity splits training into disjoint WM/IL and RL halves; validation is separate.
data_adapter.epoch_sampling: One origin per bin per epoch, cycling without replacement.
data_adapter.world_model_candidates: One factual and three candidates from other physical trajectories.
data_adapter.target: log(planar distance in metres + 0.01), masked squared error.
data_adapter.pseudo_labels: Best predicted prefix over the 64 trajectory codebook centers.
data_adapter.partition_order: Sort unique training pose keys by (SHA256(UTF8(str(seed) + ":" + pose_key)).hexdigest(), pose_key); the first floor(N/2) enter WM/imitation and the rest reinforcement.
data_adapter.dedup_representative: Within each physical pose key, retain the first (source, video) in lexicographic order after verifying identical pose and frame alignment.
data_adapter.goal_sampling: Uniformly sample one valid future keyframe within the current at-most-63-step window.
data_adapter.counterfactual_sampling: Uniformly draw a different physical trajectory, then a uniform valid origin on that trajectory; reuse its own origin-relative planar action sequence.
data_adapter.geometry_units: Forward and left in metres; yaw in radians wrapped to [-pi,pi).
data_adapter.geometry_axes: Habitat Y-up; local -Z forward; positive Y rotation turns left.

pose_key_definition.hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=False
pose_key_definition.field_meaning: Replay runtime identity, scene asset identity, scene ID, source episode start position and quaternion, and full recorded command sequence. Shared reset and commands reuse one replay geometry.

reported_checkpoints.selection: Final scheduled world model and reinforcement stages.

planning.selection: Predicted compatibility of each valid trajectory

loss_reductions.world_model: Squared log-distance error averaged over valid candidate timesteps.
loss_reductions.imitation: Cross entropy averaged over valid target tokens.
loss_reductions.reinforcement_reward: Negative world-model compatibility at the last valid decoded waypoint.
loss_reductions.advantage: Within-group centering and population standard deviation; a constant-reward group has zero advantage.
loss_reductions.likelihood_ratio: Sequence probability ratio against the fixed imitation reference; capped above at 1+clip_epsilon as in the implemented min(r,clip(r)) expression.
loss_reductions.KL: Full categorical KL at each valid token, summed along the sequence.
loss_reductions.reinforcement: Mean of -capped_ratio*advantage + beta*sequence_KL over batch and sampled trajectories.

LWM-VJEPA.preprocessing: Official short-side resize 438, center crop 384x384, ImageNet normalization.
alignment_changes: Rebuild spatial position indices for the 24x24 grid
Set policy visual token count to 576
LWM-VJEPA.remaining_settings: All other model, data, training, and planning settings are identical to LWM-CroCo.

data_comparison_scope: Same released StreamVLN source does not imply identical filtering, sample multiplicity, or training/validation splits. NoMaD uses the released checkpoint only.
